subject: OmniPay POC kickstart — format, access & load test window
messages:
From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@omnipay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: OmniPay POC Team <poc@omnipay.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 15:24:00 -0700
Subject: OmniPay POC — proposed kickoff & goals

Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at OmniPay is excited to move toward a short POC. We want a hands-on kickoff that covers:
- prompt tuning & examples (payments routing, fraud signal prompts)
- routing/variant testing (latency thresholds across our gateways)
- a short load validation (simulated shoppers, token generation throughput)

High level ask: 2.5 hour working session + 1 hour dedicated load window the following day.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Mon Jul 26, 09:00–12:00 + Tue Jul 27, 09:00–10:00
- Wed Jul 28, 13:00–15:30 + Thu Jul 29, 14:00–15:00

Would we be able to run the load test against a staging key, and can Redwood provide a short runbook for onsite AV/recording policy? We attached a draft agenda.

Attendees from our side: Sarah Lang (PM), Priya Menon (Eng), Vince Ortega (SecOps) — we’ll add more if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah Lang
Senior Product Manager, OmniPay

Attachments: OmniPay_POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (PDF agenda, 2 pages)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@omnipay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya.rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmniPay POC — proposed kickoff & goals

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the clear goals — this is exactly the right scope. Quick clarifying items so we can firm logistics:

1) Mode: do you prefer OmniPay-hosted onsite (your HQ), Redwood-hosted at our SF office, or hybrid (a few engineers onsite + rest remote)? Hybrid tends to be best for prompt review + routing demos but we can adapt.

2) Load test: what peak concurrent sessions should we simulate? Also confirm whether staging keys are okay (we prefer a staging endpoint to avoid noise on prod).

3) Recording & screen share: we can record the session for internal review. Are there redaction requirements for any screens (PCI data, tokens)? We’ll bring our own capture consent form if needed.

4) AV & visitor access: if you host, do guests need escort badges? Any machine quarantine rules (USBs, network restrictions)? If at Redwood, we’ll coordinate visitor badges and room AV — Laura, can you share the onsite runbook?

We can do the first slot (Mon Jul 26 / Tue Jul 27) if that works for your team — propose finalizing Mon Jul 26 09:00–11:30 PT for the hands-on plus Tue Jul 27 09:00–10:00 for the load window.

I’ll add a short Redwood runbook and a proposed SOW/PO next in this thread. cc: Laura (ops) and Aditya (solutions engineer) to prep runbook and load plan.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@omnipay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: OmniPay POC Team <poc@omnipay.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmniPay POC — proposed kickoff & goals

Jordan — thanks. Hybrid works best. We’ll host at OmniPay HQ but will have the PM + SecOps onsite and keep the rest remote. A few notes:

- Recording: fine to record, but anything showing PANs or full tokens must be redacted. Vince will attend to confirm.
- Load: target 50 concurrent sessions for token creation and 200 req/s across the routing tier during the 1-hour window.
- Staging keys: yes, we’ll provide a staging key and a short network ACL to allow Redwood test agents (IP list to follow).
- Visitor access: our lobby requires sign-in and escort for guests. Please provide names 24 hours before arrival.

Attendees onsite: Sarah Lang, Vince Ortega (SecOps), Priya Menon. Remote attendees TBD (we’ll share the list).

Attached is a short security spreadsheet with our questions — we answered a few items you flagged.

Sarah Lang
Senior Product Manager, OmniPay

Attachments: Security_QA_responses.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@omnipay.com>
Cc: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya.rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OmniPay POC — proposed kickoff & goals

Thanks, Sarah — that all sounds good and actionable. Summary and next steps: 

- Confirmed: Hybrid kickoff on Mon Jul 26, 09:00–11:30 PT at OmniPay HQ (on-site: Sarah, Vince, Priya; Redwood onsite: Jordan, Aditya). Load window Tue Jul 27, 09:00–10:00 PT (50 concurrent sessions; 200 req/s routing).

- Redwood will:
  • Provide an onsite runbook (attached) covering AV setup, recording consent form, and screen-redaction checklist.
  • Supply an IP allowlist and test agent container for the load test.
  • Bring two engineers onsite (Aditya and me) to lead prompt review and routing tuning.

- Action items for OmniPay:
  • Send staging key + ACLs and guest name list by Jul 25, 09:00 PT.
  • Confirm whether video recording can be shared with a limited group only.
  • Share the final remote attendee list for calendar invites.

I’ve attached our Redwood_Runbook_onsite_hybrid_v2.pdf and a draft SOW link (DocuSign) for the reserved two-engineer engagement. Please review and we’ll execute the SOW so our engineers are confirmed.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/secure/start?documentId=5f2b8a
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/OP-4821

Thanks — Laura, can you confirm the visitor badge process and send the Redwood intake form? Aditya, will you prep the load container and an initial prompt pack for the session?

Jordan Blake
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
